svg.title: A network security group on a subnet
svg.desc: Your PC, with your own public IP address, sends TCP 3389 toward the subnet snet-vm, and the temporary rule 1000 allows it. Any other source on the internet is denied by the default rule DenyAllInBound, priority 65500. The network security group nsg-azb-vm is its own resource in the resource group rg-azb-lab, outside the virtual network vnet-azb. Step 1 creates it, step 2 attaches it to the subnet, and step 3 adds the temporary rule. A virtual machine comes in Lab 12.
svg.text: Lowest number first. First match wins.
Remove the temporary rule in Clean up.
